uncuff.description: Releases the specified player from handcuffs.

jail_help.description: Shows the specified page in jail menu.

jail_throw.description: Jails the specified player in an empty jail.

jail_create.description: Creates a jail at your current location.

jail_remove.description: Removes the jail with the specified id.

jail_release.description: Releases the specified player from jail.

jail_info.description: Shows information about the specified jail.

jail_setexit.description: Without jailId: sets the GLOBAL release exit (used by every jail that has no specific exit). With jailId: sets the exit for that specific jail, overriding the global.

cop_help.description: Shows the specified page in cop menu.

cop_spawner_set.description: Sets a cop spawner at your current location.

cop_spawner_remove.description: Removes the cop spawner with the specified id.

cop_spawner_list.description: Shows all the available cop spawners.

cop_spawner_info.description: Shows the information of the cop spawner with the specified id.

cop_spawner_teleport.description: Teleports the player to the cop spawner with the specified id.

trader_help.description: Shows the specified page in trader menu.

trader_create.description: Spawns a stationary trader NPC at your location bound to <shopKey> with personality <traitId>.

trader_edit_shop.description: Retargets the trader in your crosshair to a different shop.

trader_edit_trait.description: Changes the trait of the trader in your crosshair.

trader_edit_name.description: Opens an anvil GUI to rename the trader in your crosshair; supports spaces.

trader_remove.description: Removes the trader NPC in your crosshair (within 5 blocks).

banker_help.description: Shows the specified page in banker menu.

banker_create.description: Spawns a stationary banker NPC at your location. Right-click it to open the bank GUI.

banker_edit_name.description: Opens an anvil GUI to rename the banker in your crosshair; supports spaces.

banker_remove.description: Removes the banker NPC in your crosshair (within 5 blocks).

bank_menu.description: Opens the rich banker panel (Deposit / Withdraw / Upgrade / Rename / Rewards). Phone-banking entry point.
